final_payload.rationale_summary: All four industrial production index observations were recovered and monthly growth rates were computed for the three intervals. The mean growth of the first two intervals was -1.843177114353723550162107154, while the growth for as of 1975-02-01–as of 1975-03-01 was -1.117322572285365221576394802, exceeding the mean by 0.725854542068358328585712352; therefore the later interval is the higher reference.
